cards.name: Aglovale, Lord of Frost
cards.skill_text:
Fanfare: Deal 3 damage to all enemy followers.
Intimidate
cards.flavour_text: Though I sought idealism, the path I chose to attain it was corrupt. Rather than heed the words of my trusted brothers and vassals—or anyone for that matter—I followed my own egotism and foolishly imperiled my kingdom. Never again shall I be courted by sin.
cards.evo_skill_text:
Fanfare: Deal 3 damage to all enemy followers.
Intimidate
cards.evo_flavour_text: A powerful state can't be based on affection alone, but by engendering support for the ruler's ideals. Wales must be fortified by revitalizing the economy and accepting new cultures—but only to that end, and no further.

cards.name: Alchemic Flare
cards.skill_text: Select an enemy follower on the field and deal it 4 damage. Gain an earth sigil. Skybound Art - Deal 2 damage to the enemy leader.
cards.flavour_text: Badaboom, badabow, and a bim-bam-kapow, for good measure! Here comes Clarisse, the adorable alchemy prodigy, ready for action! If I keep this up, I'll whip up something with real oomph and blow away Master Cag and the captain!

cards.name: Altruistic Aristocrat
cards.skill_text: Fanfare: Select a card in your hand and discard it. Restore 3 defense to your leader. If you selected a spell, restore 6 defense instead.
cards.flavour_text: I'm here with the bargain of a lifetime. You invest some of your time in a game with me. Win, and you get back something more precious than gold: your freedom. —Games with Goldbloom, No. 8
cards.evo_skill_text: Fanfare: Select a card in your hand and discard it. Restore 3 defense to your leader. If you selected a spell, restore 6 defense instead.
cards.evo_flavour_text: Fear not, my liege. Honor is a currency that grows as it is spent. For as long as the sun rises in the east and sets in the west, I shall defend you from your enemies. —Games with Goldbloom, No. 9: Lessons from the Chariot

cards.name: Amphibian Goldmuncher
cards.skill_text:
At the end of your turn, if you have at least 2 spells in your hand, deal 5 damage to all enemy followers.
Evolve: Add 2 copies of Glittering Gold to your hand.
cards.flavour_text: To us Flower Kami, games are a form of commerce. We exchange time for excitement. You can't win without losing something first. That's how the game works. —Games with Goldbloom, No. 4
cards.evo_skill_text:
At the end of your turn, if you have at least 2 spells in your hand, deal 5 damage to all enemy followers.
Evolve: Add 2 copies of Glittering Gold to your hand.
cards.evo_flavour_text: Time is an interesting currency. Because you're never just paying in hours, are you? You pay in missed opportunities, unearned money, and lost happiness. That's what makes this all so exciting! —Games with Goldbloom, No. 5

questions.question: I have Crest: Unkei, Goldbloom, and there's 1 spell in my hand. At the end of my turn, will Amphibian Goldmuncher's "deal 5 damage to all enemy followers" activate?

cards.name: Ara, Dawnblossom
cards.skill_text:
On Spellboost: Reduce the cost of this card by 1.
Fanfare: Select an enemy follower on the field and deal it 10 damage.
Evolve: Select another follower on the field and transform it into a Regal Falcon.
cards.flavour_text: Allow me to formally introduce myself. I am Ara of the Flower Kami, also known as the Dawnblossom. I believe games can be a force for change. Come, you pitiful soul—let us effect your transformation. —Games with Dawnblossom, No. 6
cards.evo_skill_text:
On Spellboost: Reduce the cost of this card by 1.
Fanfare: Select an enemy follower on the field and deal it 10 damage.
Evolve: Select another follower on the field and transform it into a Regal Falcon.
cards.evo_flavour_text: To go stagnant is to die. However, though your kind left us to rot among the dust and cobwebs, I would never do the same to you. One cannot blame the strangling ivy for its cruelty. One cannot blame humanity for its indifference. —Games with Dawnblossom, No. 7
